title: Exclusive-China's DeepSeek developing its own AI chip, sources say
title_zh: 独家——消息人士称中国DeepSeek正在开发自己的AI芯片
summary: July 7 () - Chinese startup DeepSeek is developing its own AI chip, according to three people familiar with the matter, a push that could reduce its reliance on Nvidia and Huawei chips, which it has depended on to train and run its globally popular models.
summary_zh: 7 月 7 日 - 据三名知情人士透露，中国初创公司 DeepSeek 正在开发自己的人工智能芯片，此举可能会减少其对英伟达和华为芯片的依赖，该公司一直依赖这些芯片来训练和运行其全球流行的模型。

title: NYSE president optimistic about forthcoming IPOs, says economy is doing 'extraordinarily well'
